articles.title: Logitech gives 7,000 employees an extra paid day off to play GTA 6 or any other video games; company says: The time employees spend playing will…
articles.description: Logitech is giving its 7,000 employees an extra paid day off to play GTA 6 or any other video game under its new Logi Game Day initiative.
